maria: Quick sync — we need to schedule a 60m threat-model + access-review for the OAuth rollout (pre-approval incoming). Looking for availability next week. Suggested slots: Tue 10-11am PT, Wed 2-3pm PT, Thu 9-10am PT. Please react with :+1: to your preferred slot or reply with constraints. I'll send the invite for the winning slot. Pre-reads here: <https://redwood.internal/docs/threats/oauth-rollout>

raj: Tue works for me. If we pick Tue, can we add a 10m agenda item on data retention for auth logs? cc @kevin

kevin: Wed is cleaner for me (deep work all morning Tue). If Tue wins I can join the second half. Also please add a data-classification row to the access matrix in the pre-read.

tess: Heads up — I'm OOO Tue+Wed. Thu is the only day I can make.

security-bot: Poll created: <https://calendar.redwood/internal/poll/abc123>. I will auto-book the slot after 48h unless someone explicitly requests a manual schedule.

luis: I can take meeting notes and draft the action tracker. Happy to summarize pre-reads as a 1-page TL;DR.

maria: Thanks. Short agenda (also in the pre-read):
1) Threat surface mapping (10m)
2) Access scope & RBAC checks (20m)
3) Retention & logs (10m)
4) Rollout mitigations + owners (20m)

Pre-read checklist (please upload or comment if you have blockers):
```
- threat model doc (2-3 pages)
- access matrix CSV (owners + current perms)
- sample logs retention policy excerpt
- list of required approvals (product/security/legal)
```

If you can't react, please reply with exact free/busy windows. I'll follow up with a calendar invite and meeting notes owner once we have a winner. :slightly_smiling_face:

tess: :wave I'll add my comments to the pre-read and I'm +1 for Thu.
